newsitem.title: USA: T.J.T. names Scott Beechie finance chief.
newsitem.headline: T.J.T. names Scott Beechie finance chief.

text.p: T.J.T. Inc said Wednesday it has promoted Scott Beechie to the position of chief financial officer, from vice president and controller.
Beechie will replace Andy Doll, who retired on March 31, the company said.
Beechie joined T.J.T. in July 1996 from West One Bancorp, where was vice president in charge of financial reporting and accounting operations. West One has since been acquired by U.S. Bancorp.
T.J.T. supplies axles and tires which are used by homebuilders to transport manufactured homes.
